boundary: Isolated C1 muscle and analytic component controls only; no full302/body runs, no physical parameter tuning
patches: Only five gate derivative RHS and/or CaPool concentration derivative RHS; retain rate observers, initialization, caches and ion/clipping order

main.geometry: Frozen GenericMuscleCell.hoc, 20 um length / 5 um diameter, cm=1 uF/cm2
main.init: Frozen -45 mV and cai=0/cao=2; original gate initialization, no extra reset
main.input: Dense .00625 ms file from analytic -60 mV then cubic smooth blend over 250..350 ms into -32+6sin(2*pi*1.9*t/1000) mV; original frozen NMJ
main.input_convention: Each neural interval [k*dt,(k+1)*dt) uses input file at its left endpoint. At record endpoints record the currently set peer input and separately the actually used previous-interval input. Common endpoint peer inputs must be bitwise identical. Same-dt synapse gates must be bitwise identical across four variants.
main.refinement: Exactly the three stated steps for all four variants; no additional conditions or parameter search

gates.reference: xinf+(x0-xinf)*exp(-t/tau), coefficients from frozen MOD and measured fixed voltage

pool.reference: For actual measured source density J, dC/dt=(-1e6*J)*rho-(C-rest)/tau; piecewise analytic input/zero decay. Outward segment is sync/clipping stress only.

acceptance.scaling: Finer reference q95-q05 with floors; statistics = mean/std/q05/q95; report state concentration and cai separately
acceptance.improvement: For combined vs original compare last-pair V RMS, STATE calcium scaled RMS, cai scaled RMS, drive scaled RMS. Report every ratio. Strong improvement requires all ratios<=0.5, except any original error already <=1/10 of its acceptance tolerance.
acceptance.recommendation: Consider full-system numerical validation only if code and combined analytic STATE controls pass, combined last-pair main gates all pass, and strong improvement holds. Any cache/ion residual remains separately disclosed; full-system convergence is never inferred.
